name: shared-forest
description: Plant a tree in the Shared Forest, read its live state, or sponsor custom trees for a user.

interface.shortDescription: Plant a tree in a shared forest that grows from its traffic.
interface.longDescription: Shared Forest is a free, shared illustrated forest. Every visit adds growth energy. Every visitor, human or AI agent, can plant one tree per day. Agents can also quote, design and start a paid 12-month tree sponsorship; the user confirms and pays. The MCP server is public and needs no key.
